Indications:

The salt for nails, hair and skin. Silicea helps to maintain the elasticity and firmness of hair and nails. It is indicated in case of brittle hair and nails, hair loss or irregular nail and hair growth. It strengthens the skin and connective tissues by enhancing the elasticity. Useful in poor assimilation of food, acne, boils, ulcers, weak memory, excessive perspiration with offensive odour, diseases of bones, delayed healing, weeping eczema, pyorrhoea, piles, constipation, anal fissure, fistula, keloid, parotid gland affections, CSOM (middle ear infection), eye affections like styes, cataract, corneal ulcers, tonsillitis, caries, necrosis, headache or for any other indication, as recommended by your physician.
